debug_menu.title: BX Debug Menu on pause
debug_menu.description: Pressing START in a race opens the developers' leftover 'BX Debug Menu' (Return To Race, Instant Replay, Restart Race, Render Options, Game Options, Sound Options, Exit the Game) instead of the normal pause menu. The menu code ships in the retail game but nothing ever pushes it onto the menu stack; this redirects the pause handler in cGame::Update to cMenuManager::Push(&gMenuManager, game->debugMenu).

patches.asm: lw   a1,0x2A0(s0)      ; a1 = game->debugMenu (was: li a2,-1)

unlock_all.title: Unlock everything from boot
unlock_all.description: Sets the flag that the built-in 'Unlock everything' button cheat toggles (gCheat_UnlockEverything, 0x3352A0), so all characters, boards, outfits and courses are open without entering the code.

max_stats.title: Max attributes from boot
max_stats.description: Sets the flag toggled by the built-in 'Max attrib' cheat (gCheat_MaxAttrib, 0x3352AC).

mallora_board.title: Mallora board from boot
mallora_board.description: Sets the flag toggled by the built-in 'Mallora' cheat (gCheat_Mallora, 0x3352B0).
